                                         BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2014-024
                                                             Technical


           Rescinds:          Buildings Bulletins 2009-009, 2009-030, 2010-001
                              TPPNs 19/88, 23/88, 1/91, 1/95, 2/98, 1/99, 6/99, 7/99, 11/99, 1/04
                              Directive 7 of 1974
                              Memorandum on enclosed balconies (June 17, 1976)
                              Memorandum on sprinkler/standpipe easements (July 10, 1980)

               Issuer:        Thomas Fariello, RA
                              First Deputy Commissioner

     Issuance Date:           December 3, 2014

            Purpose:          This bulletin rescinds 3 Buildings Bulletins (BBs), 10 Technical Policy and Procedure Notices
                              (TPPNs), 1 Directive, and 2 Memos that are no longer applicable under any code.

          Subject(s):         Buildings Bulletin, rescinded; TPPN, rescinded; Directive, rescinded; Memo, rescinded


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

Effective immediately, the following documents are to be rescinded:
         Buildings Bulletins 2009-009, 2009-030, 2010-001
         TPPNs 19/88, 23/88, 1/91, 1/95, 2/98, 1/99, 6/99, 7/99, 11/99, 1/04
         Directive 7 of 1974
         Memorandum on enclosed balconies (June 17, 1976)
         Memorandum on sprinkler/standpipe easements (July 10, 1980)

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. They will appear
on the Department website with the watermark “RESCINDED.”

Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in future
bulletins.

Watermarked BBs and TPPNs may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at:
http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/buildings_bulletin.shtml
